proposed_widenings.name: grant_light
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's entire mechanical payload is making a touched object shed Bright Light in a radius and Dim Light in a further radius. This has real mechanical consequences (visibility, hiding, Perception checks, etc.) but no atom in v4 or types.ts models light emission from an object. It is distinct from grant_sense (which gives a creature a sense) and from any existing effect atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.caster_recasts_this_spell
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell ends early if the caster casts Light again (one-at-a-time constraint). The existing DurationEndTrigger variants cover target-side events; there is no variant for 'caster recasts this same spell', which is a distinct SRD pattern appearing on several cantrips.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends if you cast it again.

proposed_widenings.name: ObjectFilter.maxSize
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell restricts valid targets to Large or smaller objects. ObjectFilter has no size field, so this targeting constraint is unrepresentable in the current surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else.

notes: The object attachment shape already works (heldOrWorn: 'forbidden'). The timed duration (1 hour, no concentration) maps cleanly to `{ kind: 'timed', value: { unit: 'hour', amount: 1 } }`. The only blockers are: (1) no grant_light atom for the core illumination mechanic, (2) no DurationEndTrigger variant for recast-by-caster, (3) no size constraint on ObjectFilter. Dhall/JSON/trace files are intentionally omitted because encoding the spell honestly requires grant_light, and a placeholder trace would misrepresent the mechanics.
